# Chewie Resource Allocation

## Overview

[Chewie](https://github.com/swirldslabs/chewie) is the compute allocation service that leases Kubernetes resources to
CITR performance and longevity tests. Instead of pinning a test run to a hard-coded cluster asset, a workflow asks
Chewie for the shape of environment it needs (how many consensus node instances, how many auxiliary instances, how much
CPU and memory each one needs, and for how long). Chewie finds capacity, provisions a namespace, and hands the workflow
back everything it needs to deploy into that namespace.

Chewie owns the lifecycle of what it allocates. The namespace is created by Chewie when the request is approved and is
reclaimed by Chewie when the allocation expires. Workflows no longer create, check, or delete namespaces themselves.

SDPT ([831: [CALL] CITR Exec SDPT](/.github/workflows/831-call-single-day-performance-test.yaml)) and
SDLT ([833: [CALL] CITR Exec SDLT](/.github/workflows/833-call-single-day-longevity-test.yaml)) acquire all of their
Kubernetes resources through Chewie. This applies to both the scheduled runs and the adhoc runs.

## Repository Configuration

Chewie reads its repository policy from [`.github/chewie.yaml`](/.github/chewie.yaml). The file is generated by Chewie
at installation time and is edited in-repo to set repository policy.

|       Key         |  Unit   |  Current Value  |                                          Description                                          |
|-------------------|---------|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `branches`        | glob(s) | `*`             | Branches from which Chewie will service allocation requests. Supports globs (e.g. `release/*`) |
| `default_duration`| seconds | `72000`         | Default allocation duration used when a workflow does not specify one                         |
| `default_timeout` | seconds | `3600`          | How long Chewie will wait for capacity before failing the request                             |
| `workflows`       | list    | *(commented out)* | Optional allowlist of workflow files permitted to request resources. If omitted, any workflow from an allowed branch may request resources |

Chewie enforces its own server-side maximum duration independently of `default_duration`.

## Required Secrets

Both [831: [CALL] CITR Exec SDPT](/.github/workflows/831-call-single-day-performance-test.yaml) and
[833: [CALL] CITR Exec SDLT](/.github/workflows/833-call-single-day-longevity-test.yaml) require these secrets. They are
no longer optional, and there is no non-Chewie fallback path.

|         Secret                |                       Repository Secret        |                     Purpose                     |
|-------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| `chewie-host`                 | `CHEWIE_HOST`                                  | Base URL of the Chewie API                      |
| `chewie-id-key`               | `CHEWIE_REPO_IDENTITY_KEY`                     | Repository identity key, exchanged for a JWT    |

## Per-Test Resource Configuration

The shape of the requested environment lives in a JSON file per test type under
[`.github/workflows/support/chewie`](/.github/workflows/support/chewie), named `<test-type>-config.json`, and is read by
[861: [CALL] Get Test Config](/.github/workflows/861-call-get-test-config.yaml).

| Test Type |                            Config File                                              | CN Qty | CN CPU | CN Mem (MB) | Aux Qty | Aux CPU | Aux Mem (MB) |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|--------|-------------|---------|---------|--------------|
| `sdpt`    | [sdpt-config.json](/.github/workflows/support/chewie/sdpt-config.json)               | 9      | 39     | 256000      | 1       | 39      | 256000       |
| `sdlt`    | [sdlt-config.json](/.github/workflows/support/chewie/sdlt-config.json)               | 8      | 39     | 256000      | 1       | 39      | 256000       |

To change the environment a test runs on, edit the JSON config for that test type. No workflow edit is required.

## Workflows

|                                    Workflow                                                            |                                                 Responsibility                                                  |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [858: [CALL] Get Chewie JWT](/.github/workflows/858-call-get-chewie-jwt.yaml)                          | Exchanges the repository identity key for a short-lived Chewie JWT                                              |
| [859: [CALL] Create Chewie Request](/.github/workflows/859-call-create-chewie-request.yaml)            | Submits the allocation request, polls until it is approved, and emits the allocation details                    |
| [860: [CALL] Validate Chewie JWT](/.github/workflows/860-call-validate-chewie-jwt.yaml)                | Validates the JWT before it is used to request an allocation                                                    |
| [861: [CALL] Get Test Config](/.github/workflows/861-call-get-test-config.yaml)                        | Reads `<test-type>-config.json` to produce the CN/aux quantities and CPU/memory requests                        |
| [862: [CALL] Get CITR Chewie Properties](/.github/workflows/862-call-get-chewie-properties.yaml)       | Reads `default_duration` and `default_timeout` from `.github/chewie.yaml`                                       |

The Chewie helper jobs run on the `hl-cn-chewie-lin-sm` runner label.

## Allocation Flow

The controllers ([201](/.github/workflows/201-user-sdpt-controller-adhoc.yaml),
[202](/.github/workflows/202-user-sdlt-controller-adhoc.yaml),
[221](/.github/workflows/221-disp-sdpt-controller.yaml), [222](/.github/workflows/222-disp-sdlt-controller.yaml))
resolve the allocation duration and timeout, then hand them to the test workflow, which performs the allocation.

1. The controller calls `862: [CALL] Get CITR Chewie Properties` to read `default_duration` and `default_timeout` from
   `.github/chewie.yaml`.
2. The controller's `Verify CITR vars` job validates that both values are present and fails the run if either is empty.
   - For the scheduled controllers (`221`, `222`) the `chewie.yaml` default is always used.
   - For the adhoc controllers (`201`, `202`) an explicit `duration-minutes` workflow input overrides the default. The
     timeout always comes from `chewie.yaml`.
3. The controller calls `831`/`833` with `duration-minutes` and `chewie-request-timeout`.
4. `831`/`833` call `858` to obtain a JWT and `861` to read the test config.
5. `860` validates the JWT.
6. The `acquire-kubernetes-resources` job calls `859`, which POSTs the allocation request and then polls for approval
   until `chewie-request-timeout` seconds elapse.
7. The approved allocation supplies the namespace, cluster FQDN, CN/aux quantities, tolerations, node roles, network id,
   owner, and expiration. The rest of the test run deploys into that namespace.
8. Chewie reclaims the namespace when the allocation expires.

## Migration Notes

The following existed while SDPT/SDLT ran on a mix of Chewie and pre-provisioned cluster assets. All of it has been
removed now that both suites run on Chewie formally.

- **`test-asset` input** — `831`/`833` no longer accept a `test-asset` input, and the controllers no longer pass
  hard-coded asset names (`SDPT1`, `SDLT2`). Chewie chooses the cluster.
- **`834: [CALL] Read Chewie Response`** — the workflow that read pre-generated allocation fixtures has been deleted,
  along with the `<Asset>-<test-type>.json` fixture files under `.github/workflows/support/chewie`.
- **`validate-chewie-inputs` job** — the Chewie secrets are declared `required: true`, so the manual pre-flight check is
  gone.
- **`acquire-kubernetes-resources-chewie` / `-legacy` fan-in** — there is now a single `acquire-kubernetes-resources`
  job. The job that normalized outputs from the two paths has been removed.
- **`delete-namespace` input and job** — Chewie reclaims the namespace at expiration, so `831`/`833` no longer expose a
  `delete-namespace` input, and the teardown job has been removed.
- **Namespace collision pre-check** — the step that scanned for an existing `chewie-solo-*` namespace and self-cancelled
  the run has been removed. Chewie guarantees a unique namespace per allocation.
- **MQPT** — Merge Queue Performance Tests and their workflows (`200`, `210`, `220`, `602`, `830`) have been removed
  entirely.
